d: Long, straight mint-green hair with blunt-cut bangs and a side-parted fringe frames a youthful face with large, expressive dark-brown eyes. This slender figure wears a dark-brown blazer over a white collared shirt with a bright orange necktie, paired with a pleated brown skirt. A brown leather strap crosses the chest, and a grey mechanical gauntlet is worn on the left wrist, while a grey metallic gear-like apparatus and naval gun components are attached to the back.
